turns.prompt_text: Are there any gas stations that offer refillable cups?
turns.response_html:
Many major gas station and convenience store chains offer refillable cup programs, often providing significant discounts for customers who bring their own mugs or purchase a branded "travel mug" from the store.

Major Chains with Refillable Programs

  • Circle K: Known for the Polar Pop and Froster programs. Many locations allow you to bring your own cup for a discounted refill price. Their Inner Circle rewards program often features drink deals, such as a flat rate (e.g., 79¢) for any size fountain drink for members.
  • Maverik: Sells branded gear like the Orange Retro Mug. Members of their Adventure Club or Nitro program receive exclusive discounts, with Nitro cardholders getting 25% off any size fountain drink.
  • 7-Eleven & Speedway: These chains frequently offer a "Coffee on Repeat" deal where any size hot coffee refill is only $1 when you bring your own mug. They also have "7REWARDS" or "Speedy Rewards" that track drink purchases; after a certain number of refills, you often earn a free one.
  • Love’s Travel Stops: They have a robust rewards program for professional drivers and frequent travelers. While they are transitioning to a credit-based model for some tiers in late 2024/2025, they historically offer unlimited or discounted refills for "Platinum" and "Diamond" rewards members.
  • QuikTrip (QT): Typically offers a discounted "refill" price for fountain sodas and coffee if you use a QT-branded travel mug or your own reusable container.

Types of Refill Options

  1. Branded Travel Mugs: Most chains sell a high-quality, insulated mug (often 20oz to 52oz). Purchasing this usually grants you a lower "refill" price for the life of the cup.
  2. "Bring Your Own" (BYOC): Many stations allow any clean, reusable mug. You simply select the "Refill" button on the checkout screen or tell the cashier it is a refill.
  3. Water Refill Stations: Some locations partner with services like Primo Water, allowing you to bring 1-gallon or 5-gallon jugs to refill at a self-service kiosk, usually located near the entrance.

Tips for Saving

  • Use the App: Almost every major chain (Casey’s, Kwik Star/Kwik Trip, Cumberland Farms) requires their app to unlock the best refill pricing.
  • Check the Size: Some "any size" refill deals have an upper limit (often 64oz).
  • Health Regulations: Due to health codes, always ensure your personal cup is clean before bringing it to a self-service station. Some stores may temporarily pause personal cup use during local health spikes.
